recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core action is needed for FHIR-5651 unless a future work group decision reopens the Condition relationship extension model in the Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-5651 was a Published Patient Care change request for DSTU1 Condition. It asked that Condition.dueTo and Condition.occurredFollowing not name their first CodeableConcept child codeableConcept; the accepted modification was to rename those children to code and create distinct bindings.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5651, but the Jira comments record the application as svn 4978. Current git history shows later same-source changes: FHIR-7620/FHIR-7621 moved Condition.dueTo and Condition.occurredFollowing out of the core Condition backbone into standard extensions, and FHIR-10102 then converted those extensions to single choice-valued value[x] extensions.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini, but source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml no longer defines Condition.dueTo or Condition.occurredFollowing. It points causality use to the condition-dueTo extension. Those relationship extension definitions now live in the FHIR Extension Pack and use Extension.value[x] with distinct bindings, ConditionCause and ConditionPredecessor. A remaining QUICK library model mentions dueTo and occurredFollowing, but its DueTo and OccurredFollowing classes use code and target rather than codeableConcept, so it does not preserve the issue's stale naming problem.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Editing current core Condition would reintroduce obsolete backbone-element concepts, while editing the Extension Pack is outside this core checkout and unnecessary for this issue because the read-only extension-pack evidence already matches the material intent.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the dueTo and occurredFollowing split that FHIR-5651 later refined.
Moved dueTo and occurredFollowing from core Condition backbone elements to extensions.
Renamed the target child to detail while moving the old elements out of core.
Changed dueTo and conditionFollowing extensions to CodeableConcept-or-Reference value[x] choices.
